اجلعدوا (form IVq)
# اِجْلَعَدُّوا (ijlaʕaddū) /id͡ʒ.la.ʕad.duː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِجْلَعَدَّ (ijlaʕadda)
# اِجْلَعِدُّوا (ijlaʕiddū) /id͡ʒ.la.ʕid.duː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِجْلَعَدَّ (ijlaʕadda)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
